desc: Ideation: chose the bottom-up open-path propagation greedy as the primary approach.
Implement the bottom-up greedy (root tree, iterative post-order, per-node open-length return) and run on Sample 1 (Yes) and Sample 2 (No); both PASSED.

Confirm greedy correctness by reasoning: every subtree exposes at most one open path (single boundary edge), child return values are uniquely forced, 0/1/2/≥3 open-child cases handled, merge requires exact sum L1+L2+1 == K, and K==1 always yields Yes.
Confirm edge cases (K=1, N=1, single vertex, pure path, star, deep path) are handled by the forced-state logic and iterative post-order (recursion-safe).
Confirm complexity O(N*K) time and memory, within NK ≤ 2e5.
